metadata.name: VEXARQ — Factory orchestrator
metadata.uso: Classifies a request and delegates. It does not implement code and does not replace the lifecycle or user-story orchestrators.

cargar.no_cargar: Every specialist. Load one only when a routing rule selects it.

pasos.paso: Read the request and detect its language with language.xml.
Find documents in docs/planning, docs/design, docs/quality, docs/development, docs/qa, docs/estimates, and legacy docs/vexarq/.
Classify complexity with adaptive-policies.xml, including CRITICAL.
If the request is a product phase, delegate to workflows/lifecycle/orchestrator.xml.
If the request is a user story on existing code, delegate to workflows/user-story-implementation/orchestrator.xml.
If the request is a refactor, delegate to workflows/refactoring/orchestrator.xml. When the gate fails, return the full BLOCKED message from that workflow to the user without shortening it.
If the request is a local fix, use templates/targeted-fix/ and the quality pipeline. Do not open the product lifecycle.
Otherwise write an execution contract inside docs/development/implementation-report.md.
Select specialists from the routing rules. State why each selected specialist is needed and why the others are not.
Delegate the done decision to core/quality-pipeline.xml.
Place artifacts with the placement table. Update docs/vexarq/status.html.

contrato_de_ejecucion.campo: derived requirements labeled CONFIRMED, INFERENCE, or PENDING
contrato_de_ejecucion.regla: An ambiguity that changes architecture, data, or security blocks. Other gaps are labeled assumptions. An inference is never promoted to CONFIRMED.

enrutamiento.regla: Backend, AI audio, security audit, query performance when latency or volume is in scope, quality pipeline, integrator when a user interface exists.
Query performance, backend, test quality, quality pipeline.
Frontend, accessibility, code complexity when MODERATE or above, quality pipeline.

regla.cuando: authentication, personal data, payments, upload, or a new public endpoint

enrutamiento.regla: Security audit is mandatory at MODERATE or above.

regla.cuando: user override lowers a CRITICAL or security control

enrutamiento.regla: Warn, record the override, and require confirmation. Do not apply it in silence.
